examined_formations.title: CHINA_WUHAN_HEALTHCARE_INFORMATION_AI_SOFTWARE_COMPLETED_70_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_POSITIVE_POST_PURCHASE_REVENUE_AND_PROFIT_BUT_NEGATIVE_CASHFLOW_AND_UNCLOSED_HUMAN_DELIVERY
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Shanghai JHCT Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. previously held 32% of Boke Guoxin (Wuhan) Technology Co., Ltd. and in 2026 acquired an additional 38%, taking its holding to 70% and control.
The target's industrial-and-commercial change was completed in April 2026 and the target was brought into the listed company's consolidation scope after control was obtained.
The 2026 half-year acquisition accounting table reports purchase-date-to-period-end revenue of RMB47,818,486.68, net profit of RMB8,147,334.98 and cash flow of negative RMB2,264,954.34.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The target provides healthcare digital-information solutions including medical SPD supply-chain, HRP, integration/data-governance and county medical-consortium platforms, plus AI-oriented products.
The incremental 38% control acquisition consideration was approximately RMB73.7102 million, with the overall target valuation around RMB194 million.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The acquirer moved from a non-controlling 32% position to 70% control rather than merely taking a minority financial stake.
The transaction thesis is operational integration between the acquirer's hospital automation position and the target's healthcare information platforms rather than a passive asset yield.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is a true completed-control packet with same-target post-purchase positive revenue and positive net profit.
The purchase-date-to-period-end cash-flow measure is nevertheless negative, so positive accounting profit does not close positive post-transfer cash generation.
Public evidence does not close target employee count, owner/replacement labor, project-implementation effort or customer-specific integration burden.

Healthcare data, hospital-system integration and enterprise deployment rights remain customer- and institution-dependent; the acquired software company does not evidence a universally callable machine transaction rail.
The acquisition consideration and expected use of bank financing are far outside a small-operator bounded-capital position.
economic_signal: Incremental 38% control acquisition consideration approximately RMB73.7102 million; post-transaction holding 70%.
Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB47.8185 million and net profit RMB8.1473 million.
Purchase-date-to-period-end cash flow negative RMB2.2650 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The acquired control surface is specialized healthcare software, implementations and domain relationships, not a generic agent layer.
The target has genuine domain-specific systems and IP, but realization depends on hospital customers, integrations, data governance and project delivery.
No evidence shows a self-serve external demand/settlement rail that a small operator can own without recurring enterprise implementation.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_SHANGHAI_FABLESS_SENSOR_CHIP_COMPANY_COMPLETED_100_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_POSITIVE_POST_PURCHASE_REVENUE_AND_PROFIT_BUT_NEGATIVE_CASHFLOW_AND_EXPERT_RD_DEPENDENCE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: MIXC Integrated Circuits Shanghai Co., Ltd. completed the 100% acquisition of Shanghai Xinyan Microelectronics Co., Ltd. with the industrial-and-commercial change registered on 2026-03-20 and control obtained from that date.
The 2026 half-year accounting table reports acquisition cost of RMB160 million and a 100% acquired interest.
Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue was RMB29,833,883.71, net profit RMB10,833,129.44 and cash flow negative RMB826,527.31.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The target is a fabless integrated-circuit design company focused on magnetic sensor chips and motor-drive related products.
A fabless model avoids owning a wafer fab but still depends on specialized R&D, design verification, customer design-in, foundry/supply-chain coordination and technical support.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The acquirer bought the entire company rather than only licensing one product or purchasing inventory.
The acquisition combines chip/product capability with the acquirer's existing integrated-circuit business and therefore transfers corporate IP/control as a going concern.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The control transfer is complete and post-purchase revenue/net profit are positive, satisfying a much stronger continuity test than a listing.
Purchase-date-to-period-end cash flow is still negative.
The acquired value requires recurring semiconductor R&D, product iteration, customer technical engagement and upstream manufacturing coordination rather than autonomous machine operation.
The RMB160 million purchase price is not bounded small-operator capital.
economic_signal: Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB29.8339 million and net profit RMB10.8331 million.
Purchase-date-to-period-end cash flow negative RMB0.8265 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The noncommodity asset is specialized semiconductor IP, product know-how and customer/supply relationships.
A generic agent cannot replace the technical IP position, but neither can the business operate without recurring expert R&D and supply-chain execution.
The evidence therefore supports a specialized technology company, not a machine-delegatable routing control asset.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_NINGBO_RENEWABLE_O_AND_M_PLATFORM_COMPLETED_70_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_POST_ACQUISITION_SEGMENT_REVENUE_BUT_UNCLOSED_TARGET_CASHFLOW_AND_FIELD_ENGINEER_DEPENDENCE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Shenzhen Sunrise New Energy Co., Ltd. completed the industrial-and-commercial registration for its 70% acquisition of Youde New Energy Technology (Ningbo) Co., Ltd. on 2026-05-29 and consolidated the target.
The deal uses RMB100 million fixed consideration plus up to RMB56.8 million conditional consideration tied to profit commitments.

The acquirer's 2026 half-year reporting states that the acquired UniCare/Youde operations capability was integrated with its data platform and that its new-energy smart O&M segment produced RMB17.4668 million of revenue in the reporting period.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The target is described as a light-asset third-party renewable-asset operations-management provider with more than 100 county/city service centers, historical service to more than 2,000 stations/projects and more than 10GW of managed scale.
The UniCare platform and related software include scheduling, station health, lifecycle and finance-management functions.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The buyer sought control specifically to integrate the target's operating network and platform capability into a broader renewable-asset data/operations system.
The business deliberately combines software with a nationwide professional O&M engineer/service-center network.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The 70% control acquisition is complete, so this is not a proposed-transfer case.

However, the publicly reported RMB17.4668 million is the acquirer's smart-O&M segment revenue; the current packet does not isolate purchase-date-to-period-end target revenue, target net profit and target operating cash flow as one accounting packet.
The operating model explicitly depends on professional field O&M engineers and more than 100 local service centers, so the software platform does not remove recurring expert/physical delivery.
Potential consideration up to RMB156.8 million and performance-security structure are not small-operator bounded capital.
economic_signal: 70% control acquisition completed 2026-05-29; fixed consideration RMB100 million plus up to RMB56.8 million conditional consideration.
Buyer reported RMB17.4668 million of new-energy smart O&M segment revenue in 2026 H1 after the acquisition, but target-specific post-purchase net profit/cashflow are not isolated.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The platform has real software/data assets, but delivery also relies on a geographically distributed professional O&M network.
The same human-service footprint that supports coverage weakens machine-delegatability and small-operator replication.
No evidence shows that the software alone owns a callable external action/settlement rail independent of field service execution.
